Ravi K (SE): starting StratusBank POC thread — they require BYO KMS/HSM for envelope encryption + runtime unwraps. New asks: rotation window <=3h, support for ephemeral KEKs per session, and documented two-custodian dry-run. Also want a capped monthly pricing option for predictable billing.
Maya T (AE): pricing Q — is wrap/unwrap billed as key_ops separate from token billing? Customer wants prepaid-block option + overage cap.
Ravi K (SE): yes: wrap/unwrap = key_ops. Proposal: monthly proxy fee + per-op meter OR prepaid blocks with burst overage. I'll draft two tiers.
Jon S (Security): SQ: need vendor attestation (FIPS level), SOC2 artifacts, proof that plaintext KEKs never leave customer HSM, and signed provenance for each wrap/unwrap. Also ask for optional escrow with neutral provider (wrapped blob only).
Eli P (SRE): attestation + perf: we can provide vendor-signed attestation and p50/p95/p99 metrics. Typical unwrap ~5-30ms + proxy hop; cache option reduces median. We can HMAC-sign provenance events and stream to their Splunk/S3 endpoint. Default retention 90d (extendable).
Renee (Deal Ops): quote flavors: 1) managed key-proxy (we run proxy in customer VPC), 2) private on-prem package. Include PS for ceremony facilitation (8h), runbook, and an escrow facilitation add-on. Add optional 24/7 on-call and extended log retention.
Maya T (AE): acceptance criteria for POC: 1) E2E encrypt/decrypt with customer KEK; 2) rotation at <=3h with zero dropped requests; 3) 95p end-to-end gen latency <=180ms; 4) signed provenance and audit stream to customer's SIEM. Can we stream to Splunk HEC?
Ravi K (SE): yes — we can stream JSON events to Splunk HEC, Datadog, or S3. Will include schema and signing header.
Jon S (Security): split-custody: can Redwood act as ceremony orchestrator without holding shards? They want a two-person ceremony with neutral escrow.
Eli P (SRE): yes — Redwood can orchestrate and only accept wrapped KEK. We'll publish verification hashes and a dry-run checklist. No plaintext leaves customer HSM.
Ravi K (SE): sample bind snippet for docs:
```
redwoodctl kms bind --mode byo \
  --key-arn arn:cloudhsm:us-west-2:acct:key/str-909 \
  --proxy https://proxy.stratus.example --mtls-cert /etc/stratus.pem
```
Maya T (AE): legal flagged indemnity — customer wants a narrower liability carveout for BYOK. Legal will default to "customer retains custody risk" language; escalate if customer insists on more.
Renee (Deal Ops): I'll produce two-variant quote + SOW with PS lines and escrow add-on. Will attach attestation bundle once infra uploads it.
redwood-artifacts-bot: uploaded artifact: stratus-poc/attestation_and_runbook.zip
Ravi K (SE): thanks all — syncing with finance for per-op bands and prepaid pricing. Will follow up in 24h. :white_check_mark:
